name: Entity Change
description: Provides the framework for entity change plugins.
project_description: Entity Change is a developer-only plugin framework for detecting arbitrary changes on updated content entities (nodes, terms, users, and other content entities). It defines an EntityChange plugin type whose plugins compare the updated entity against its original (pre-update) copy and answer a single boolean 'did this specific change happen?' question. Plugins declare which entity type and bundle they apply to via a 'type' string (e.g. 'node:*' or 'node:article'), and the plugin manager (EntityChangeManager) finds, instantiates and filters the applicable plugins for a given (entity, original) pair. It ships three example node plugins (Node Just Published, Node Just Unpublished, Re-titled) and does nothing on its own: other modules or automation (e.g. ECA/rules-style tools) call the manager to react to detected changes. Because it relies on the 'original' entity that core attaches during entity update hooks, it works only on content entities.
